questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.Only one person sits between A and C, when counted from the left of C. G sits third to the right of E. D sits third to the left of B. G sits to the immediate right of D. F is not an immediate neighbour of D. How many people sit between A and G, when counted from the right of A?
In a certain code language, ‘EXAM’ is coded as ‘2379’ and ‘MADE’ is coded as ‘9278’. What is the code for ‘D’ in the given code language?

Sourav starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards south. He then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 17 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (4 km to the west) है।

Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows. You must assume everything in the information to be true.The incidence of waterborne diseases in Village E has risen sharply over the past year. A public health investigation linked this rise to the contamination of the village's main water source by sewage. Health officials recommend the immediate repair and upgrading of the village’s sewage system to prevent further contamination.Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?I. Contamination of the water source by sewage contributes to waterborne diseases in Village E.II. Residents of Village E will be soon evacuating the village.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Only I follows.) है।
